scenes.text: Bulking? Eating every fucking thing in sight is not the move, bro.
Dirty bulk: pizza, donuts, shakes all day. Some muscle, and a fucking lot of fat.
Lean bulk: a small surplus, mostly real food, pizza sometimes. And lift fucking hard every week, adding weight.
Slower gains, but way more of that weight is muscle and a lot less fucking fat.
Skip the dirty bulk. Lean bulk fucking wins.

caption: Bulking? Eating everything in sight mostly adds fat. Eat a small surplus of mostly real food, keep pizza for sometimes, and add weight to the bar every week so more of what you gain is muscle. Save this for your next gym day.
